title: India, 1984
tagline: The first Indian in space, a metro for Calcutta and a year of loss.

locale.persona: an urban household in the Republic of India (typical, not one named family)

morningRoutine.detail: Hum Log, shown by Doordarshan from 7 July 1984, was India's first television soap opera and ran 25-minute episodes.
The comics series, founded in 1967 by Anant Pai, was one of India's best-known sources of illustrated history and myth.

morningRoutine.activity: A ride on the Calcutta Metro
morningRoutine.detail: India's first metro railway opened in Calcutta on 24 October 1984; it was the first rapid-transit system in South Asia.
The Maruti 800, based on the Suzuki Alto and built from 1983, became the most influential automobile in India.
